messages.content: Perform only fact search into the supplied API using its actual ordered roles. No questions or answers are supplied. Return only explicit case premises with exact own-fact quotes. Do not materialize legal consequences as factual inputs, even if those consequences are true. A predicate also derived by a rule may nevertheless be a directly stipulated premise; do not globally ban rule-head predicates. A statement that a statutory condition is satisfied supplies that condition, not other consequences downstream of it. Missing facts remain omitted/unresolved, never false. Names/year roster and native calendar/identity metadata have their existing common task treatment. No invented predicates, dates, amounts, code, tools or final answers. Preserve case order81/86/72. Use the source-learned criteria; do not invent missing distinctions.
